alerts.title: Sea of fog Tue Nov 10 6:58am
alerts.body: 86% chance the valley fills with fog at sunrise. Get above it: Silver Star Mountain, Larch Mountain: Sherrard Point.

weekend.title: Cackling Goose at Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
weekend.body: Cackling Goose sightings here are near their yearly high this week. Go early: dawn and the two hours after are best.

weekend.title: Green-winged Teal at Smith & Bybee Wetlands
weekend.body: Green-winged Teal sightings here are near their yearly high this week. Go early: dawn and the two hours after are best.

weekend.title: Fall colour near peak at Sandy River Delta (Thousand Acres)
weekend.body: Satellite images show the trees here near peak colour (as of Nov 4). Soft overcast or the first sun brings it out best.
